channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Canadian Dollar slides with Oil prices, US CPI fails to keep US Dollar higher
item.description: USD/CAD rises 0.27% on Friday and trades around 1.3870 at the time of writing, after reaching a daily high of 1.3882 in the immediate reaction to the release of United States (US) inflation data.

item.title: United Kingdom: Growth outlook strengthens with AI-driven services – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Chief UK Economist Sanjay Raja highlights stronger-than-expected UK GDP data, with July output rising 0.4% month-on-month and broad-based gains across services, production and construction.

item.title: US UoM Consumer Sentiment Index is seen at 47.8 in September
item.description: American consumer confidence is expected to have lost some traction in September, as households have been growing more pessimistic about current conditions and the broader economic outlook, according to preliminary data from the University of Michigan.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Dovish stance leaves PLN vulnerable against Euro – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky notes that the National Bank of Poland maintained a dovish stance, signalling no need to adjust rates potentially until mid-next year despite rising inflation.

item.title: European Central Bank: Hawkish rate path supports Euro – UOB
item.description: UOB economist Lee Sue Ann notes that the European Central Bank (ECB) delivered a widely expected 25 bps hike but signalled a more hawkish stance as inflation risks from the Middle East-driven energy shock remain elevated.

item.title: Gold rallies despite stronger Fed rate-hike expectations following US CPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its advance on Friday, reversing most of the previous day’s losses despite increased Federal Reserve (Fed) interest-rate hike expectations following the release of the latest United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) report.

item.title: Bank of Japan: Hawkish hike prospects grow – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research analysts Taimur Baig and Chang Wei Liang expect the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to hike rates by 25 bps at its September 17–18 meeting, citing solid Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth, stronger wages and inflation near the 2% target.

item.title: Japanese Yen strengthens as US inflation fails to sustain Dollar rebound
item.description: USD/JPY falls 0.54% on Friday and trades around 153.60 at the time of writing.

item.title: Euro steadies against US Dollar after volatile reaction to US CPI
item.description: EUR/USD reverses earlier losses on Friday after the latest United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) report came broadly in line with expectations and failed to trigger a strong market reaction.

item.title: Oil: Gradual easing as dark transits grow – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank strategists argue that Brent crude should gradually retreat toward pre-war levels as covert tanker “dark transits” and diversions restore Gulf supply.

item.title: Breaking: US CPI inflation stays unchanged at 3.4% in August as anticipated
item.description: Annual inflation in the United States (US), as measured by the change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), held steady at 3.4% in August, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday. This print came in line with the market expectation.

item.title: WTI drops more than 4% below $97 as profit-taking kicks in, Iran tensions limit losses
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil drops 4.54% on Friday and trades around $96.00 at the time of writing.

item.title: Euro: ECB hawkish path supports pair – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports EUR/USD is trading heavy around 1.1600 after a hawkish 25 bps European Central Bank (ECB) hike to 2.50%. President Lagarde called the move a “no brainer” and signaled more hikes as inflation is seen above target for an extended period.

item.title: US Dollar: Strength builds on yields – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes that the Dollar is benefiting as global bond yields and Oil prices rise, with the USD re-establishing a positive correlation with long-end US yields.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: Neutral bias holds as 0.8600 caps the upside
item.description: EUR/GBP edges lower on Friday, drifting toward the lower end of the range seen over the past week.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Yield pressure risks fresh losses against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong highlights a rebound in USD/JPY as higher US Treasury yields, stronger US Dollar (USD) and elevated Oil prices support the pair, even as expectations for further BOJ normalisation cap upside.

item.title: Indian Rupee cracks this week amid higher oil prices, US bond yields
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its downward spiral against the US Dollar (USD) for the fourth trading day on Friday, with the USD/INR pair rising to near 95.80.

item.title: Euro retreats below 1.1600, Dollar appreciates heading into the US CPI release
item.description: The Euro (EUR) accelerates its reversal against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, as the impulse from a hawkish hike by the European Central Bank (ECB) fades.

item.title: Oil: Supply risks and central bank inflation worries – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights that Brent has approached $110 as Houthi advances near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait raise concerns over Red Sea shipping and broader supply chains.

item.title: Japanese Yen outperforms this week as market bets on BoJ's extended tightening cycle
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) bounces back against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after a sharp corrective move the previous day. In the European trade, the USD/JPY is down 0.3% to near 154.00 at the time of writing.

item.title: European Central Bank: Hawkish path toward December peak – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Mark Wall and colleagues say the European Central Bank delivered a 25bp hike to 2.50% in September, with President Lagarde describing it as a no‑brainer.

item.title: US Dollar: CPI volatility risk and limited upside – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the US Dollar (USD) is supported by recent risk aversion and a modestly hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) repricing after US August Producer Price Index (PPI), but stresses that August Consumer Price Index (CPI) will be decisive for next week’s Fed meet

item.title: Australian Dollar climbs on RBA rate hike expectations as traders await US CPI
item.description: AUD/USD advances 0.17% on Friday and trades around 0.7170 at the time of writing. The Australian Dollar (AUD) benefits mainly from growing expectations of further interest rate hikes by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA), following a series of hawkish comments from central bank officials.

item.title: SNB’s Schlegel: Inflation accelerates in recent months but remains within stability range
item.description: Swiss National Bank Chairman Martin Schlegel said during the European trading session on Friday that the Swiss Franc exchange rate has been a challenge for the Swiss economy. However, headed that the real Franc has been stable since 2020.

item.title: Swiss Franc nears monthly lows as investors brace for US CPI data
item.description: The Swiss Franc extends losses for the sixth consecutive day against the US Dollar on Friday, nearing one-and-a-half-month lows at the mid-0.8100s.

item.title: British Pound: Support at 1.3495 under pressure against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that GBP/USD’s sharp drop to 1.3493 looks stretched short term, favouring consolidation between 1.3495 and 1.3535 intraday.

item.title: Australian Dollar steadies vs Japanese Yen as hawkish RBA signals offset JPY strength
item.description: AUD/JPY trades around 110.50 on Friday at the time of writing, posting a modest 0.04% decline on the day. The pair remains broadly stable as both the Australian Dollar (AUD) and the Japanese Yen (JPY) benefit from growing expectations of monetary tightening by their respective central banks.

item.title: Czech Koruna: CZK faces downside risks against Euro into CNB – ING
item.description: ING analysts David Havrlant and Frantisek Taborsky say the Czech market is being driven mainly by global factors and high energy prices, but EUR/CZK still reacts to Czech National Bank (CNB) meetings and guidance.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD clings to a key support area around $4,300
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) nudges higher on Friday, as the US Dollar’s (USD) recovery stalls ahead of the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) release, due later in the day.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.04 per troy ounce, up 0.72% from the $63.58 it cost on Thursday.
